newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol invests 222.4 bln ptas in 9 months.
newsitem.headline: Repsol invests 222.4 bln ptas in 9 months.

text.p: Spanish energy group Repsol said on Tuesday its investments through September reached 222.42 billion pesetas.
Of these, 84.09 billion were destined to refining and marketing and include 23.32 billion for the purchase of Argentine refinery Astra, Repsol said in a statement on nine-month earnings.
A further 62.24 billion were dedicated to exploration and production, of which 45 percent is linked to the Astra purchase associated with exploration and production.
The company invested 57.83 billion in gas, of which 58 percent corresponds to investments in infrastructure for natural gas transport and distribution.
It gave no further details on investments.
